strings.zh: 哦呀,今天的第一位挑战者来啦。{NEWLINE}欢迎欢迎！{SCROLL}咱们四之岛巡礼的规则很简单,{NEWLINE}干就完事了。{CLEAR}你只要能打败我,{CLEAR}就算你完成了四之岛的巡礼。{CLEAR}怎么样,现在要开始吗？
strings.en: Oh ho, here comes today’s first{NEWLINE}challenger. Welcome, welcome!{SCROLL}The rules of our Four Island Pilgrimage{NEWLINE}are simple: just go for it. Beat me, and{CLEAR}you’ve completed the Four Island{CLEAR}Pilgrimage. So, want to start now?
strings.notes: Sky Pillar Peak (Four Island): Four Island chief's trial; Proton and Ariana catch Rayquaza with the Jade Orb. #22/#24 male, #23/#25 female player.

strings.zh: 哈哈,这就让你看看{NEWLINE}水都群岛第一大力士的风采。
strings.en: Ha ha! Now I’ll show you the might of{NEWLINE}the strongest man in the Alto{CLEAR}Mare Islands.

strings.zh: 仔细一看……{NEWLINE}您是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}大人吧？{CLEAR}难怪刚才我越打越觉得不对劲,{CLEAR}怎么可能会有这么厉害的游客嘛。{SCROLL}总之我输得心服口服,{NEWLINE}恭喜您完成了四之岛的巡礼,{CLEAR}您如果还没完成诸岛巡礼,{CLEAR}现在可以去其他岛看看了。
strings.en: Now that I look closely... You’re{NEWLINE}League Champion {VAR:0103:0}, aren’t you?{CLEAR}No wonder something felt more and more{CLEAR}off the longer we fought. How could a{CLEAR}tourist possibly be that strong?{SCROLL}Anyway, I lost fair and square.{NEWLINE}Congratulations on completing the Four{CLEAR}Island Pilgrimage. If you haven’t{CLEAR}finished the Island Pilgrimage yet, you{CLEAR}can go visit the other islands now.

strings.zh: 战槌龙『Raaa——pa！
strings.en: Rampardos: Raaa-pa!

strings.zh: 冠军大人,我已经认可您{NEWLINE}通过了四之岛的巡礼考验。{CLEAR}您如果还没完成诸岛巡礼,{CLEAR}现在可以去其他岛看看了。
strings.en: Champion, I’ve recognized that you{NEWLINE}passed the Four Island Pilgrimage trial.{CLEAR}If you haven’t finished the Island{CLEAR}Pilgrimage yet, you can go visit the{CLEAR}other islands now.

strings.zh: 身上的绿色宝珠{NEWLINE}感受到了天空的气息,{CLEAR}正在隐隐发出绿色的光辉。{CLEAR}要使用绿色宝珠看看吗？

strings.zh: 烈空坐『Rayyy——qua！

strings.zh: 四之岛正在举行诸岛巡礼,{NEWLINE}你们既然不是参加巡礼的挑战者,{CLEAR}就请离开天柱峰！
strings.en: Four Island is holding the Island{NEWLINE}Pilgrimage. Since you aren’t challengers{CLEAR}in the pilgrimage, please leave Sky{CLEAR}Pillar Peak!

strings.en: Proton: We, Team Rocket, are on a{NEWLINE}mission here. Get lost if you don’t want{CLEAR}to die.

strings.en: Team Rocket?!{SCROLL}You’re Team Rocket, that notorious{NEWLINE}criminal gang from the mainland?!

strings.zh: 好啊,居然跑到水都群岛{NEWLINE}来破坏诸岛巡礼,{CLEAR}真是卑劣至极的行为,{CLEAR}我作为四之岛岛主可不能坐视不理！{SCROLL}战槌龙,使用诸刃头突！
strings.en: So! You’ve come all the way to the Alto{NEWLINE}Mare Islands to wreck the Island{CLEAR}Pilgrimage? That’s as low as it gets! As{CLEAR}chief of Four Island, I can’t just stand{CLEAR}by and watch!{SCROLL}Rampardos, use Head Smash!

strings.zh: 兰斯『螳臂当车,自取灭亡。{NEWLINE}战槌龙,让他看看什么才是{CLEAR}真正的诸刃头突！
strings.en: Proton: A mantis trying to stop a cart.{NEWLINE}You’re asking to be crushed.{CLEAR}Rampardos, show him what a real Head{CLEAR}Smash looks like!

strings.zh: 不……战槌龙！
strings.en: No... Rampardos!

strings.zh: 兰斯『下一个就轮到你了,臭乡巴老。
strings.en: Proton: You’re next, you stinking{NEWLINE}old hick.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『今天有我在这里,{NEWLINE}你们休想伤害任何人！

strings.zh: 你是……冠军大人？

strings.en: Proton: Hey! Ariana! That meddling{NEWLINE}Champion followed us here. You’d{CLEAR}better hurry!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『真的是这小子,这下可不妙了。{NEWLINE}我现在就用绿色宝珠召唤烈空坐,{CLEAR}你们给我拖住他！

strings.zh: 雅典娜『真的是这丫头,这下可不妙了。{NEWLINE}我现在就用绿色宝珠召唤烈空坐,{CLEAR}你们给我拖住她！
strings.en: Ariana: It really is that girl. This is{NEWLINE}bad. I’ll summon Rayquaza with the Jade{CLEAR}Orb right now. Hold her off!

strings.zh: 兰斯『你们两个,先给我消耗一下他！
strings.en: Proton: You two, wear him down for{NEWLINE}me first!

strings.zh: 兰斯『你们两个,先给我消耗一下她！
strings.en: Proton: You two, wear her down for{NEWLINE}me first!

strings.zh: 是！
strings.en: Yes, sir!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『让开,我没空跟你们浪费时间。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Out of my way. I don’t have{NEWLINE}time to waste on you.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『现在该轮到你了,兰斯！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Now it’s your turn, Proton!

strings.zh: 兰斯『呸,你就只有气势唬人而已,{NEWLINE}我才不怕你呢！
strings.en: Proton: Pfft. All you’ve got is bluster.{NEWLINE}I’m not scared of you!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『我以绿色宝珠的名义{NEWLINE}召唤你降临,出来吧烈空坐！
strings.en: Ariana: In the name of the Jade Orb, I{NEWLINE}summon you to descend. Come{CLEAR}forth, Rayquaza!

strings.zh: 进入战斗。
strings.en: Battle start.

strings.zh: 雅典娜『哈,想跟我对战吗烈空坐？{NEWLINE}但是我可没有那个时间,{CLEAR}去吧,特制球！

{VAR:0103:0}: No! Stop!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『真遗憾啊联盟冠军,{NEWLINE}这次就差一点点。{CLEAR}但不得不说你这条达马兰奇的狗,{CLEAR}鼻子倒是越来越灵了。
strings.en: Ariana: Too bad, League Champion. So{NEWLINE}close this time. But I have to say, for{CLEAR}Goodshow’s dog, your nose is getting{CLEAR}sharper and sharper.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『还不晚！{NEWLINE}只要在这里把精灵球抢回来……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: It’s not too late! If I can{NEWLINE}just get that Poké Ball back here...

strings.zh: 雅典娜『蠢货,我们什么时候{NEWLINE}给过你这种机会。{CLEAR}全体撤退！
strings.en: Ariana: Idiot. When have we ever given{NEWLINE}you that kind of chance?{CLEAR}Everyone, retreat!
{VAR:0103:0}: Dammit, not again...

strings.zh: 冠军大人……
strings.en: Champion...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『对不起,我没能保护好烈空坐……

strings.zh: 虽然烈空坐被火箭队抓走了,{NEWLINE}但我能感受到您和您的精灵之间{CLEAR}有着坚如磐石的信赖。{CLEAR}无论火箭队夺取多少传说中的精灵,{CLEAR}都不可能战胜您这样的训练家。
strings.en: Rayquaza may have been taken by Team{NEWLINE}Rocket, but I can feel the rock-solid{CLEAR}trust between you and your Pokémon. No{CLEAR}matter how many legendary Pokémon Team{CLEAR}Rocket steals, they could never beat a{CLEAR}Trainer like you.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『谢谢您的鼓励。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Thank you for{NEWLINE}the encouragement.

strings.zh: 现在火箭队已经离开,{NEWLINE}我必须得继续担负起岛主的职责{CLEAR}主持完成四之岛的诸岛巡礼才行。{CLEAR}所以请恕我不能远送了。

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『说起诸岛巡礼,{NEWLINE}其实我在七之岛报名参加了巡礼,{CLEAR}这次来到天柱峰{CLEAR}也是为了完成四之岛的巡礼。{CLEAR}请问您的考验是什么呢？

strings.zh: 原来冠军大人也在进行诸岛巡礼啊。{SCROLL}一般来说,完成四之岛的考验{NEWLINE}需要先通过海岛洞穴,{CLEAR}然后在天柱峰与我交战并打败我。{CLEAR}不过冠军大人的实力{CLEAR}我刚才已经亲眼目睹,{CLEAR}我完全没有打败您的胜算,{CLEAR}所以就算您通过四之岛的考验了。
strings.en: So you’re doing the Island Pilgrimage{NEWLINE}too, Champion?{SCROLL}Normally, to complete the Four Island{NEWLINE}trial, you first have to make it through{CLEAR}the Island Cave, then battle and beat{CLEAR}me on Sky Pillar Peak. But I just saw{CLEAR}your strength with my own eyes,{CLEAR}Champion. I don’t stand a chance of{CLEAR}beating you, so consider the Four{CLEAR}Island trial passed.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这样啊……也好,{NEWLINE}那我再去其他岛看看吧。

strings.zh: 嗯,祝您一路顺风。
